surveyor_request: Re-run upstream-caller extraction and seed-function analysis using the already captured caller evidence and the installed NMS.exe. No derelict traversal is needed.
user_steps: In Research, click Extract upstream callers + upload. This is offline and uses the saved caller capture plus your installed NMS.exe.
When that finishes, click Analyze seed function + upload.

If either action fails, return to this chat with the diagnostic. Also attach dungeon-caller-code-latest.json and dungeon-upstream-callers-latest.json from %LOCALAPPDATA%\NMSDerelictSurveyor\asset-work-v1.
success_condition: Surveyor reports the analysis completed and GitHub contains a new timestamped seed-lineage upload with the upstream-caller and seed-function analysis JSON.
evidence_to_return: The timestamped seed-lineage upload folder and run manifest, or the diagnostic plus the two named local evidence JSON files.
